description: This file defines a helper class 'LiteLLM_Proxy_MCP_Handler' with static methods for managing MCP (multi-channel protocol) integration within an LLM response framework. It includes functions for parsing tools, managing tool execution, transforming tools, extracting calls from responses, creating streaming responses, and handling MCP-related events. The class facilitates communication with MCP servers, processing tool calls, and integrating their results into the conversational flow.

classes.name: LiteLLM_Proxy_MCP_Handler
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to manage MCP server interactions, tool parsing, response handling, and streaming operations within the context of the Responses API integration for MCP.
